title: Extend the coverage gate to the component layer
change: Add 'src/components/**' to coverage.include. Set that path's threshold to the measured current value rounded DOWN to the nearest 5, minimum 50. Record the number.
exit: cd frontend && pnpm run coverage  →  exit 0
forbidden: Do NOT lower the existing 80% threshold for src/core or src/adapters to make the build pass.
escalate: Measured component coverage is below 30% — that is a bigger conversation than a threshold.
